summary: Extends re-presentation to prose and research output (claim extraction, citation verification pipeline, numeric registry, summary-first reading). Gives a three-stage recommendation plan: immediately cap units at ~200 LOC and sessions at 60-90 minutes, require self-explanation blocks, name one accountable human; this quarter adopt spec-driven review, adversarial second-model pass, package validation, risk tiering; ongoing, auto-generate summaries and track churn. Ends with caveats on vendor sources, 2006-era limits, correlation, and preprint status.

claims.text: Hallucinated legal citations have produced sanctions in more than a thousand tracked cases worldwide
If AI PR defect or churn exceeds ~1.5x human baseline, tighten to full line-by-line review and shrink chunks
Approvals faster than ~300-500 LOC/hour should be treated as rubber-stamping
The 200-400 LOC and 60-90 minute limits come from 2006 human-code data, not re-derived for AI diffs
The 64.53% direct-review figure merges evaluative feedback with workflow acknowledgments, so it overstates substantive review
GitClear churn/duplication trends are correlational with AI adoption, not causal

risks.note: 'More than a thousand tracked cases' names no tracker or source.
1.5x threshold and 300-500 LOC/hour cutoff are author-chosen; no derivation given.
Numeric-registry whitelist approach recommended with no evidence it works.

least_confident: The origin of the action thresholds in the 'Thresholds that change the plan' paragraph, which read as author judgment rather than sourced values.
